about.p1: Software Engineering student at PUC Minas, focused on backend development, data analysis, and process modeling. I'm driven by a hands-on mindset and a constant pursuit of efficient and innovative solutions.
about.p2: Currently at TSA Engenharia, I work on management system development. I use agile methodologies and AI tools strategically to optimize code writing, ensuring productivity and technical scale in deliveries.

p1.title: G-AGRO
p1.description: Award-winning interdisciplinary project at PUC Minas. A full-stack web platform for agricultural management, developed collaboratively by a team of students. Live at g-agro.vercel.app.

p2.title: n8n Challenge
p2.description: Custom n8n node to generate true random numbers using the Random.org API. Built with TypeScript and containerized with Docker and PostgreSQL. Includes unit tests and error handling. Developed as a technical challenge for an internship at Onfly.

p3.title: Xubank
p3.description: Modular banking system built in Java for the Modular Programming course at PUC Minas. Simulates a digital bank with client management, multiple account types, transactions, reports, and a login authentication system.

p4.title: Jogo de Adivinhação
p4.description: Number guessing game in Java where the player tries to guess a randomly generated number between 0 and 100. The game provides feedback at each attempt, indicating whether the guess was too high or too low.
